notes: Wisconsin embeds a published Outlook calendar; its ICS feed was read directly. The feed only holds events from 10 April 2026 forward (older entries drop off), so October 2025–March 2026 is rebuilt from conference news posts and is therefore less complete than the months after April 2026. The calendar mixes committee meetings (marked internal) with ministry events. Hispanic ministry (JAHWI youth federation, campestre, caravana) is very visible: the 50th anniversary of Hispanic work in Wisconsin on 30 May 2026 drew about 1,350 people, and a new Hispanic church (Beloit) was organized in July 2026. Where the calendar and a news post disagree on dates, the calendar date is kept and the news date is given in a note. The conference also gained a Hmong-language pastor in March 2026 (news).
